programme_facts.value: The Build a Map tool provides transfer course recommendations for a selected transfer institution with a specific undergraduate degree program at ASU. It allows for outlining a transfer map by selecting almost any regionally accredited domestic institution and almost any ASU major.
Users can favorite multiple transfer maps, allowing exploration of how transfer coursework could apply to various ASU majors.
Building and saving a transfer map allows users to track progress by adding details about where and when they plan to complete degree requirements.
Once admitted to ASU, students work with an Academic Advisor in their college to review the official major map for their catalog year.
The transfer map is a proactive planning tool that is replaced by the official degree audit (DARS) once students start their academic career at ASU.

Arizona State University welcomes visiting university students and is proud to provide students enrolled in other colleges and universities with opportunities to stay on track academically and advance toward your goals.
